Concentration-round first-touch (triage seat): promoted `finding` → `pm:queue`, Task S. Closes the three recorded phantom-cleans-in-waiting: author `items` for `element:definition-list` (cheap, pure schema), and a per-target adapter override / data-bearing fixture for `element:repeater` + `element:metadata_viewer` — keeping `FAKE_ADAPTER`'s empty answer load-bearing for everyone else, as the card requires. Discipline stands: re-measure, and a leak found is a **new ledger row recording a measurement**, never a predicted one; `READY_OVERRIDE_REASONS` shrinks by three in the same change (its two-way pin will insist). Sequencing: inside the #5632 burn-down family — the ui seat may fold this into the ledger campaign's first batch per the five gates, or land it first as the fixture-depth prerequisite.

All three renderers read CLEAN in the populated branch (no LEAK_LEDGER rows added; traced -- neither renderer file spreads the props bag onto any DOM element in any branch), and reverse-verification (a deliberately planted leak on each newly-reached host element) confirmed the deepened fixtures actually catch a leak the old placeholder-only fixture structurally could not reach, then was reverted uncommitted before the real fix was committed.",
